about_the_game:
Unique Co-Op Bike Controls

You share control between two players! Each has their own role. Cooperate, communicate, and play together—because you have one goal!

One player controls the throttle, keeping you safe from deadly traps, while the other steers, finding the best path—the path to the top!

Master teamwork, or the journey will be nearly impossible.

Test Your Friendship and Teamwork!

Two friends decide to take on an unusual challenge—a tandem bike race held at the peak of a mountain. But they never expected the road to the competition to be this dangerous and unpredictable.

To make it to the top, you'll have to navigate through office buildings, busy highways, and even construction sites—where every obstacle will test your teamwork.

An unforgettable adventure filled with challenges and excitement awaits!

Strictly for Two!

This game is designed for cooperative play—you’ll need a reliable partner who’s ready to work as a team. Grab a friend, a family member, or just a daring soul willing to take on this challenge with you.

Going solo? Not an option!

A Grand Journey Through Ever-Changing Locations

Dynamic landscapes and unexpected obstacles will keep you on your toes. From peaceful amusement parks to chaotic construction zones, every location is unique and demands a fresh approach.

You never know what’s waiting around the next corner.

A Challenge for Everyone

Three difficulty levels let you choose your own adventure:

  • Easy – A relaxed ride with frequent checkpoints.

  • Medium – Tougher challenges and fewer checkpoints.

  • Hardcore – No mercy, no checkpoints—just pure focus and skill!

Are you ready to prove you can conquer any height?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8/10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-4170 @ 3.7Ghz OR Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
